ptr.note: AVClass-enabled object (first member a non-NULL const AVClass *), or a pointer to a const AVClass * alone (cpu.c and fftools pass &pclass); only read for the call. set_string_number looks the value up as a named constant of o->unit in it (av_opt_find, with AV_OPT_SEARCH_CHILDREN through child_next when o has AV_OPT_FLAG_CHILD_CONSTS), lists the unit's constants with av_opt_next, and logs in its context (item_name, log offsets read). NULL: no constants, no context. Wrapped as opt::EvalContext (an ObjectRef, or a ClassRef C sees through a local class pointer).

Option entry of a static class table; NULL or a type other than exactly AV_OPT_TYPE_FLAGS (arrays included) or AV_OPT_FLAG_READONLY returns AVERROR(EINVAL). Reads type, flags, unit, default_val, min, max, name; need not belong to obj's class. Wrapped as the OptionDefRef receiver.

Value string, parsed during the call only. AV_OPT_TYPE_FLAGS is evaluated token by token: an optional '+'/'-', then at most 255 bytes up to the next '+'/'-' (copied into buf[256]; an empty token evaluates the whole rest), each token looked up as a CONST of o->unit or parsed as its own av_expr_parse_and_eval expression. A token cut at the 255-byte limit starts inside what the whole string reads as one name or number, so a check of the whole string cannot stand in for the tokens: '0*' + 253 zeros + 'ld(1e300)' evaluates ld(1e300), converting 1e300 to int unchecked (UBSan eval.c float-cast-overflow). opt::flags_refusal checks every token with eval::refuses (options wave-2 review). Must not be NULL.

Caller's int slot. Read first: a '+'/'-' token ORs into / clears from its current value; each token's result is written as it is evaluated, so a failing later token leaves earlier writes. Never retained; wrapped as a Rust out value.
